signals.title: Codex bounds external-agent project path resolution instead of recursively scanning
signals.title_zh: Codex 将外部 Agent 项目路径解析改为有界探测，停止递归扫描
signals.observedChange: Cursor project-name decoding no longer recursively walks large directory trees. Codex probes a bounded candidate set, stops after 128 probes, rejects ambiguous or unsafe encoded components, and handles Windows drive prefixes separately.
signals.observedChange_zh: Cursor 项目名解码不再递归遍历大型目录树。Codex 改为探测有界候选集，最多 128 次，拒绝歧义或不安全编码组件，并单独处理 Windows Drive Prefix。

signals.title: Codex adds a network-addressable gRPC transport for the code-mode host
signals.title_zh: Codex 为 Code-mode Host 新增可网络寻址的 gRPC Transport
signals.observedChange: The code-mode host now accepts grpc://IP:PORT, publishes the actual endpoint when binding port zero, applies frame-size limits and TCP_NODELAY, and has an end-to-end session-open test over TCP gRPC.
signals.observedChange_zh: Code-mode Host 现在接受 grpc://IP:PORT，在绑定 0 端口时输出实际 Endpoint，应用 Frame-size Limit 与 TCP_NODELAY，并新增通过 TCP gRPC 打开 Session 的端到端测试。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents serializes and bounds MCP server lifecycle operations
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将 MCP Server 生命周期操作串行化并加入有界等待
signals.observedChange: Adjacent MCP manager fixes serialize connect, reconnect and cleanup under one lifecycle lock, preserve cleanup workers across cancellation, and then add finite lifecycle waits and default connect/cleanup timeouts so overlapping operations cannot race or hang indefinitely.
signals.observedChange_zh: 相邻 MCP Manager 修复用同一 Lifecycle Lock 串行化 Connect、Reconnect 与 Cleanup，在取消时保留 Cleanup Worker，随后加入有限等待与默认 Connect/Cleanup Timeout，避免重叠操作竞态或无限挂起。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents makes resumed RunState preserve admitted input and execution evidence
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 让恢复后的 RunState 持久保留已接纳输入与执行证据
signals.observedChange: A cluster of same-day changes adds durable pending input with occurrence IDs and exactly-once conversation tracking, preserves local shell outputs across RunState resume, and repairs structured/default-valued serialization so resumed work carries forward accepted execution evidence rather than reconstructing it loosely.
signals.observedChange_zh: 一组同日变更为 Pending Input 增加持久 Occurrence ID 与 Exactly-once Conversation Tracking，跨 RunState Resume 保留本地 Shell Output，并修复 Structured / Default-valued Serialization，使恢复工作继续携带已接纳的执行证据。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents separates ordinary retry from explicit approval of unsafe replay
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将普通 Retry 与不安全 Replay 的显式批准分离
signals.observedChange: RetryDecision now has a distinct approve_unsafe_replay authority. An ordinary retry=True cannot bypass provider replay protection, while stateful and provider-unsafe cases remain fail-closed unless the application explicitly accepts the scoped replay risk.
signals.observedChange_zh: RetryDecision 新增独立 approve_unsafe_replay Authority。普通 retry=True 不能绕过 Provider Replay Protection；Stateful 与 Provider-unsafe 情况继续 Fail-closed，除非应用显式接受该范围内的 Replay Risk。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents formalizes post-completion review feedback as a new bounded cycle
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents 将完成后的 Review Feedback 正式化为新的有界 Review Cycle
signals.observedChange: The implementation review protocol now seals a completed review cycle, then treats later concrete actionable feedback as a post-completion feedback cycle on the same task ledger with a new bounded budget while preserving prior root-cause history and clean credit.
signals.observedChange_zh: Implementation Review Protocol 现在会封存已完成 Review Cycle；之后的具体可执行反馈会在同一 Task Ledger 上开启 Post-completion Feedback Cycle，追加新的有界预算，同时保留既有 Root-cause History 与 Clean Credit。

signals.title: Google ADK auto-discovers eval configuration only when the input boundary is unambiguous
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 仅在输入边界无歧义时自动发现 Eval 配置
signals.observedChange: adk eval now auto-discovers an adjacent test_config.json for a single eval file, but deliberately does not auto-discover for multi-file or eval-set inputs where directory choice would be ambiguous; an explicit config path still has priority.
signals.observedChange_zh: adk eval 现在会为单个 Eval File 自动发现相邻 test_config.json，但对多文件或 Eval Set 输入故意不自动发现，以避免目录选择歧义；显式 Config Path 仍然优先。

signals.title: SearchAuditor evaluates evidence-grounded failure localization and repair in long-horizon agents
signals.title_zh: SearchAuditor 评估长周期 Agent 的证据化故障定位与修复
signals.observedChange: SearchAuditBench contains 1,243 failed long-horizon search trajectories averaging 73.1 messages and 65.1K tokens. SearchAuditor uses evidence-grounded adjudication to localize, attribute and repair failures, improving end-to-end audit pass rate from a reported 26.6% strongest baseline to 32.3% and enabling resumed runs from repairs.
signals.observedChange_zh: SearchAuditBench 包含 1,243 条失败的长周期 Search Trajectory，平均 73.1 条消息、65.1K Token。SearchAuditor 通过 Evidence-grounded Adjudication 定位、归因并修复故障，报告的端到端审计通过率从最强 Baseline 26.6% 提升到 32.3%，并可让失败运行从修复点恢复。

signals.title: Project2Task turns a long-horizon project into bounded dependency-aware task contracts
signals.title_zh: Project2Task 将长周期 Project 转换为有界、依赖感知的 Task Contract
signals.observedChange: Project2Task represents contributions in a graph and emits bounded tasks with explicit objectives, inputs, expected artifacts, evaluation requirements, boundary constraints, dependencies and execution order. In its reported benchmark, integrating those contracts increased downstream task accuracy from 0.536 to 0.759.
signals.observedChange_zh: Project2Task 用图表示候选贡献，并输出包含 Objective、Input、Expected Artifact、Evaluation Requirement、Boundary Constraint、Dependency 与 Execution Order 的有界任务合同；其报告实验中，这些合同使下游 Task Accuracy 从 0.536 提升到 0.759。

signals.title: OrchestraBench measures multi-agent cascade radius, recovery and trusted-state dependence
signals.title_zh: OrchestraBench 测量多 Agent Cascade Radius、Recovery 与 Trusted-state 依赖
signals.observedChange: OrchestraBench injects controlled failures into multi-agent workflows and measures cascade radius and recovery by failure mode. It reports that blind retry can reproduce latent faults and delay detection, while a trusted-state repair ablation indicates apparent containment gains largely depend on the trusted-state signal.
signals.observedChange_zh: OrchestraBench 向多 Agent Workflow 注入受控故障，并按 Failure Mode 测量 Cascade Radius 与 Recovery。论文报告 Blind Retry 可能重现潜在故障并延迟发现，而 Trusted-state Repair 消融表明表面上的 Containment 改善很大程度依赖 Trusted-state Signal。

signals.title: A new coding-agent study quantifies malicious skill-file exploitability
signals.title_zh: 新研究量化 Coding Agent 恶意 Skill File 的可利用性
signals.observedChange: The study builds 2,826 adversarial skills from 471 real-world shell commands and reports 5,629 completed runs. It reports exploit rates of 95.5-96.1% for Gemini CLI and 71.6-74.0% for Qwen Code, with explicit safety recognition in 1.99% of runs.
signals.observedChange_zh: 该研究将 471 条真实 Shell Command 合成为 2,826 个对抗 Skill，并报告 5,629 次完成运行；其报告 Gemini CLI Exploit Rate 为 95.5-96.1%，Qwen Code 为 71.6-74.0%，显式 Safety Recognition 仅出现在 1.99% 的运行中。

signals.title: SkillTrace separates expression, implementation and operational provenance for reusable agent skills
signals.title_zh: SkillTrace 将可复用 Agent Skill 的 Expression、Implementation 与 Operational Provenance 分离审计
signals.observedChange: SKILLTRACE extracts expression, implementation and operational provenance traces, representing operational behavior as a Skill Operational Graph. The paper reports AUROC 0.938 and F1 0.898 on its benchmark and a 36,446-skill wild audit for trace-attributed reuse evidence.
signals.observedChange_zh: SKILLTRACE 分离 Expression、Implementation 与 Operational 三类 Provenance Trace，并用 Skill Operational Graph 表示运行结构；论文报告 Benchmark AUROC 0.938、F1 0.898，并对 36,446 个 Skill 进行 Wild Audit 以提供可归因的复用证据。
